protocol.regression: Delta encoder drive on intercept,cos(theta),sin(theta), globally across independent positions. P is orthogonal projector onto the two direction coefficient vectors; intercept excluded.
protocol.shams: Three fixed rank2 subspaces orthogonal to learned direction subspace, each scaled to exact per-input projected-component norm; both deletion and restoration tested.
protocol.secondary_subspace: Harmonics1-3,rank6 fit-only diagnostic; no outcome-based subspace selection.
